control.title: Customer protection and grievance redressal
control.description: Give customers secure-usage guidance, an easy in-app and web route to report fraud and raise complaints, a named grievance officer and escalation matrix, online dispute resolution and refund timelines, and disclose risks and charges before they sign up.

evidence_hint: Grievance policy, website and app screenshots, complaint register with turnaround times, ODR process.
acceptance_criteria: A published grievance officer, escalation matrix and complaint route in the app or website
A complaint or dispute register with resolution times
Customers can report fraud directly in the app or website

criteria_coverage.criterion: A published grievance officer, escalation matrix and complaint route in the app or website
A complaint or dispute register with resolution times
Customers can report fraud directly in the app or website

requirements.title: Dispute mechanism and refund timelines
requirements.guidance: A dispute resolution mechanism with refund timelines, following RBI's turnaround-time rules for failed transactions.

requirements.title: Grievance officer and escalation matrix on the website
requirements.guidance: Name a grievance redressal officer and publish the escalation matrix.

requirements.title: Risk alerts, masked notifications and fraud flagging
requirements.guidance: Online alerts on failed transactions, velocity and geo-location; masked account and card details; merchant name (not the gateway) in messages with the OTP at the end; customers can flag fraud in the app or website.
